verdict.rationale: Turso's docs show a Free tier with strong durability guarantees (99.999999999%, docs-45) and the architecture supports spinning up many isolated per-user/per-project databases cheaply (docs-12/48), and a hands-on community report notes 'cold start times are basically zero now' (turso-comm-6), consistent with scale-to-zero behavior. However, no vendor documentation explicitly states idle databases scale to zero cost or spells out the pricing mechanics for dormant projects. Missing for 10: explicit scale-to-zero/idle-cost documentation, pricing page detail on inactive database billing, independent benchmark confirming zero cost for idle prototypes.
